# Tobi Oladimeji

> Founder, product builder, and data and AI professional based in Waterloo Region, Ontario, Canada. Builds products, explores ideas, and solves business problems through technology.

Tobi is the founder of Data Fellows, a global AI and data community with 1,600+ members across 33+ countries, and Inscend, an ecommerce technology company. He also advises Granted Technologies Inc. on data architecture and AI-assisted workflows, and supports AI data training and evaluation at Cohere.

## Current work

- **Data Fellows** (https://datafellowsai.com/): A global AI and data community with 1,600+ members across 33+ countries. Professional development, technology education, community building, and industry partnerships.
- **Inscend** (https://www.inscend.io/): An ecommerce technology company helping independent merchants understand, adopt, and make better use of technology. Previously developed and launched an AI-powered B2B SaaS product, piloted with Shopify merchants and backed by a development and referral agreement with SHOPLINE. Selected as a finalist at SAAS NORTH AI PitchFest 2026 and OBSIDI BFUTR 2026.
- **Granted Technologies Inc.**: Strategic advisor on data architecture, quality controls, workflow design, and AI-assisted grant-data processes.
- **Cohere**: AI data training and evaluation, independent contractor.

## Previous venture and leadership experience

Co-founded Venture Learning Collective (2026), a venture-building and funding-readiness initiative for early founders. Secured a C$2,800 micro-grant from Weston Frontlines and delivered a six-session Youth Funding Readiness Lab.

## Background

Previously worked as a Data Analyst at PwC (Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 F&O migration), a Data Analyst & Machine Learning Engineer at ESGTree (Power BI, SQL/Python, LLM-based document extraction), and a Data Analyst at AgroMall (operational dashboards). Postgraduate Diploma in Business Analytics from Conestoga College; B.Sc. in Computer Science from Landmark University.

## Notable projects

- Inscend Source Agent and Granted Source Agent: Gemini-powered AI agents (with Google Search grounding) that discover and score leads and non-dilutive funding opportunities.
- Several Power BI, SQL, and Python data-analysis projects, listed at https://tobioladimeji.com/#work.
